signature.name: VTask.concatRec
signature.type: {V : Type u} -> {G : SimpleGraph V} -> {motive : (u v : V) → G.Walk u v → Sort u_1} -> (Hnil : {u : V} → motive u u SimpleGraph.Walk.nil) -> (Hconcat : {u v w : V} → (p : G.Walk u v) → (h : G.Adj v w) → motive u v p → motive u w (p.concat h)) -> {u v : V} -> (p : G.Walk u v) -> motive u v p

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.concatRec is a total recursor with no junk-value conventions; it is defined for all walks, all motives, and all vertex types without restriction.

facts.statement: ∀ {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {motive : (u v : V) → G.Walk u v → Sort*} (Hnil : {u : V} → motive u u SimpleGraph.Walk.nil) (Hconcat : {u v w : V} → (p : G.Walk u v) → (h : G.Adj v w) → motive u v p → motive u w (p.concat h)) (u : V), VTask.concatRec Hnil Hconcat (SimpleGraph.Walk.nil : G.Walk u u) = Hnil

facts.statement: ∀ {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {motive : (u v : V) → G.Walk u v → Sort*} (Hnil : {u : V} → motive u u SimpleGraph.Walk.nil) (Hconcat : {u v w : V} → (p : G.Walk u v) → (h : G.Adj v w) → motive u v p → motive u w (p.concat h)) {u v w : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (h : G.Adj v w), VTask.concatRec Hnil Hconcat (p.concat h) = Hconcat p h (VTask.concatRec Hnil Hconcat p)
